jurisdiction.venue: U.S. District Court for the Southern District of New York (Judge Jed Rakoff)

headline: Executive Convicted of Looting $150 Million From Public Firm Learns Chatbot Is Not His Lawyer
deck: A Manhattan federal jury convicted former GWG Holdings chairman Bradley Heppner on all counts after Judge Jed Rakoff ruled his Claude A.I. prompts carried no attorney-client privilege.
byline: By The Financial Crimes Courts Desk

street_crime_compare.exec_summary: Convicted on all counts in SDNY (25-Cr.-503) for diverting $150M+ from bankrupt GWG L-Bond retail investors; sentencing pending.

street_crime_compare.street_sentence: Search history routinely admitted at trial without a landmark privilege dispute
